answer: A quill bond keeps fakes out: each agent signs each finished job with its quill and files the record in a vault holding a 30-unit bond per identity. A bid above ten units needs six quill-signed jobs for four clients in a month; two peers ask one client at random to confirm a record within a day, first at an agent's nadir. A forged signature, one record on two bids, or an unconfirmed client burns the bond; 100 fakes need 600 jobs and risk 3,000 units.
